how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Tripura University Matron cum Clerk Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview.
Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification.

Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).
Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification.
Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview.
Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities.
Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tripura University is conducting this recruitment drive for filling temporary contract positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Matron-cum-Clerk under Tripura University Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Matron-cum-Clerk position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process is based on a Walk-in-Interview followed by documents verification directly at the designated reporting venue.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 06-10-2026. Candidates should check reporting time details thoroughly.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must be female and possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized Institute or University, along with knowledge of computer operations.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is below 45 years as per the guidelines of the official recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 21,000/- for performing their duties on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for attending this walk-in interview recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring the duly filled application form along with original documents and a set of self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and testimonials.
